theorem_1.name: LEGEND_CHARACTERIZATION
theorem_1.statement: Under the frozen Legend contract and the standard deterministic polynomial-time model, TRUMP_UNIVERSAL_PROOF_CARRYING_DECOMPOSITION_LEMMA holds if and only if 3SAT is in P, equivalently if and only if P=NP.
forward_direction: L1 gives total progress/terminal coverage for every 3-CNF input.
L3 bounds charged discovery/compilation/local work per macrostep by a fixed polynomial in original input size N.
L4 bounds live state/proof material by a fixed polynomial in N.
L5 bounds the number of nonterminal macrosteps by ceil(N^d).
Therefore the composed deterministic computation decides 3SAT in polynomial time.
Because 3SAT is NP-complete under polynomial-time many-one reductions, P=NP.
reverse_direction: Assume P=NP, hence 3SAT has a deterministic polynomial-time decider A.
Use standard SAT self-reducibility to recover a satisfying assignment in polynomially many calls to A on SAT inputs.
For UNSAT, run A to rejection and expose a polynomial-length deterministic computation transcript as independently checkable metadata.
Define D to solve the whole input in one terminal macrostep; all state/work/transcript sizes are polynomial.
Use Phi_F(start)=1 and Phi_F(terminal)=0, satisfying the integer-valued Legend rank requirement.
Thus all six Legend obligations can be realized.
theorem_1.consequence: The existential Legend Lemma is a characterization of P=NP, not a known weaker intermediate theorem.

theorem_2.name: UNSAT_CERTIFICATE_SUBFRONT
theorem_2.statement: If the UNSAT side of one total Legend constructor always terminates with polynomial-size independently polynomial-time verifiable certificates, then UNSAT_3CNF is in NP and therefore NP=coNP.
theorem_2.cook_reckhow_connection: Cook-Reckhow: a polynomially bounded propositional proof system exists if and only if NP=coNP.

reference.authors: Stephen A. Cook; Robert A. Reckhow
reference.title: The relative efficiency of propositional proof systems

dependency_cleanup.L5_interpretation: L5 is exactly a polynomial bound on macrostep count expressed as a discrete rank certificate; it must not be mistaken for an independent algorithmic source of progress.

two_effective_fronts.meaning: Universal exact polynomial-size verifiable terminal/decomposition evidence, especially on UNSAT inputs.
two_effective_fronts.complexity_landmark: NP=coNP-level on the universal UNSAT certificate side

two_effective_fronts.meaning: One deterministic algorithm finds the required exact evidence/transition in polynomial total work.
two_effective_fronts.complexity_landmark: Combined with exact totality this is P=NP-level

next_direct_attack.question: For one frozen exact proof language/constructor, can deterministic proof/decomposition discovery be proved polynomial without assuming the target decision result or using answer-dependent advice?
forbidden: existential short-proof arguments presented as discovery algorithms
